import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sumArr = new long[10];
    static long[] powArr = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long n;
    static long cntA, cntB, total;
    static BufferedReader br;
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static char getNextChar() throws IOException {
        return (char) br.read();
    }

    static long getNextInt() throws IOException {
        long sign = 1, num = 0;
        char ch = getNextChar();
        while (!Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = getNextChar();
        }
        do {
            num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
            ch = getNextChar();
        } while (Character.isDigit(ch));
        return sign * num;
    }

    static void printNumber(long x, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (x < 0) {
            sb.append('-');
            printNumber(-x, sb);
            return;
        }
        if (x >= 10) printNumber(x / 10, sb);
        sb.append((char) (x % 10 + '0'));
    }

    static void printAnswer(long x) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        printNumber(x, sb);
        sb.append('\n');
        System.out.print(sb.toString());
    }

    static boolean checkCond(long x) {
        long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999L <= n && x * limit * 10 > n;
    }

    static void buildVectors(int depth, long prefix) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        val[depth].add((cntA - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1);
        sumArr[depth] += (cntA - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1;
        cntA++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            buildVectors(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void processNode(int depth, long current) {
        if (current > n) return;
        if (checkCond(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long temp = ((cntB + 1 - (current * powArr[i]) % MOD1) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], MOD1 - temp);
                long size = val[i].size();
                total += (sumArr[i] + temp * size - MOD1 * (size - pos));
                total %= MOD2;
            }
            cntB += cntA;
        } else {
            cntB++;
            total += ((cntB - current) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            total %= MOD2;
            for (int d = (! (depth != 0) ? 0 : 1); d <= 9; d++) {
                processNode(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = getNextInt();
        buildVectors(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        cntB = -1;
        total = 0;
        cntA = 0;
        processNode(0, 0);
        printAnswer(total);
    }
}
